tasks.short: Monitor orderly passenger flow at checkpoints

steps.what: Monitor passenger flow and guide orderly movement through screening checkpoints

tasks.design: Keep live observation and passenger guidance with the screener. Existing instructions in {DOCS} remain a reference; no reliable structured queue-state feed is established here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Orderly movement depends on changing conditions and people needing assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: No new validated sensing or control capability is supplied for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a local obstruction or passenger need before it disrupts the queue.
tasks.human_edge: The screener responds to the situation and gives clear personal guidance.
tasks.altitude: The screener retains live flow-management responsibility.

reach.task: Describe congestion that needs additional support
reach.learn: Separate direct observations from estimated causes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checkpoint flow monitoring includes live observation and responsive passenger interaction.

assumptions: Boundary is the screener's live flow observation and guidance; staffing plans and security screening decisions belong elsewhere.
Screener produces observations during s1 and all observation, interpretation and communication time is retained. No congestion code, queue sensor or safe-capacity flag is presumed.
Check existing approved checkpoint tools before adding software; their runtime is not new labour saved.
Zero upkeep because the proposal changes neither tools nor procedures.
unknowns: Current queue layout and accessibility needs
research_questions: Which flow problems require supervisor action rather than routine passenger guidance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Observation and personal assistance keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain authorised options for prohibited items

steps.what: Inform passengers of permitted mailing options for prohibited items
Confiscate prohibited items where authorised and complete the required handover

tasks.design: Keep explaining options and authorised physical item handling with the screener. A current reference in {DOCS} can support explanations, but it does not decide the disposition of an individual item.
tasks.previous_blocker: Passengers need an understandable explanation and items require authorised handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing procedures provide reference information without replacing the interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed restrictions and cases where a mailing option is unavailable.
tasks.human_edge: The screener explains the available options and acts within the applicable authority.
tasks.altitude: The screener keeps explanation and item-handling responsibility.

reach.learn: Follow local identity and chain-of-custody requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explaining prohibited-item options and carrying out an authorised physical handover require direct staff involvement.

assumptions: Boundary begins after the item is identified; mailing and confiscation are alternative case paths with aggregate shares, not mandatory consecutive outcomes. Postal fulfilment and later custody work are outside the denominator.

Existing screening staff identify the item and policy owner publishes current rules before this task. Screener checks the case and captures required item identity, reason and handover details within s2's 40 hours; unclear authority triggers manual escalation. No confiscate flag is supplied automatically.
Use existing approved references before code; runtime earns no saving. European operator and national rules determine permitted options rather than a US-specific rule.
Zero upkeep because no changed technology or procedure is proposed.
unknowns: Permitted local mailing and item-handling options
research_questions: Which passenger questions most often require clarification of the locally permitted options?

approvals.approved_version: Exact item identity, applicable authority, reason and intended custody handover checked before action in s2; changed facts require fresh approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Passenger explanation and physical handling remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer passenger questions and provide directions

steps.what: Provide directions and respond to individual passenger inquiries

tasks.design: Keep individual passenger questions with the screener. Site information in {DOCS} can be consulted when needed; an assumed self-service channel does not establish that the live interaction disappears.
tasks.previous_blocker: A question may reflect unfamiliarity, accessibility needs or a changed site condition.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing signs and reference information support staff but do not quantify new savings.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding what the passenger needs and communicating it clearly.
tasks.human_edge: The screener can adapt an answer and recognise when another staff member is needed.
tasks.altitude: Passenger assistance remains part of the role.

reach.task: Support a passenger needing additional help

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: individual directions and inquiries require understanding the question and current site context.

assumptions: Boundary is general directions and inquiries, excluding screened-baggage pickup directions owned by the separate task.

Screener establishes the passenger's question during s1 and verifies any uncertain site detail manually; all capture and checking time is retained. No structured intent or accessibility flag is presumed.
Check existing site references and signs before new software; their runtime is not a new saving.
Zero upkeep because no new channel or process is introduced.
unknowns: Frequency of changed routes or facilities
research_questions: Which recurring inquiries remain unresolved by current signs and staff references?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No assumed question deflection is counted as saved staff time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct passengers to screened baggage pickup

steps.what: Direct passengers to their baggage pickup area after screening is complete

tasks.design: Keep baggage-pickup directions with the screener using the current checkpoint arrangement. Instructions in {DOCS} do not replace checking whether the relevant screening process is complete.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directions depend on the passenger's immediate situation and the active pickup arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional validated routing capability is supplied for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding confusion between bags awaiting resolution and bags available for pickup.
tasks.human_edge: The screener can observe confusion and clarify directions immediately.
tasks.altitude: The screener retains direct pickup assistance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checkpoint pickup assistance is a direct interaction tied to current screening and site arrangements.

assumptions: Boundary covers pickup directions only, excluding security disposition, baggage retrieval and general inquiries counted elsewhere.

Existing authorised screening process supplies completion information before directions are given; the screener checks the relevant case in s1's retained time. Unclear completion requires manual clarification, not an inferred ready flag.
Test existing approved references before adding tools; current runtime earns no new labour saving.
Zero upkeep because no new process or system is proposed.
research_questions: Where do passengers most often confuse pending baggage with completed-screening pickup?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. The task remains direct passenger assistance.

role.altitude: Protect live observation and passenger assistance while keeping item disposition within authorised human procedures.
reach: Give clear handovers to passenger assistance staff and item custodians
role.ambitious_version: A screener who maintains orderly flow and gives understandable guidance without treating system information as a substitute for case judgement.
